component.name: Overlook
component.summary: A clear view of what matters

description.p: Overlook is a beautiful, considered mail client for Linux. A familiar workspace for reading, writing, and keeping your day in view.
Thoughtfully made for Linux. Overlook by Last Refuge.
Create calendar events by dragging across empty time, right-click an event to edit, duplicate or delete it, and confirm before deleting an event that has guests.
Tidy the sidebar: folders sort alphabetically and nest under the Inbox in any spelling, your own folders get a collapsible section, and arrows, icons and names line up.
Add account and folder management, folder windows, persistent Undo and history, settings search, and Omarchy theme integration. Improve IMAP synchronization and folder-only mailbox support.
Fix recipient autocomplete in To, Cc and Bcc, preserve surrounding recipients when editing replies, and handle quoted contact names correctly.
